visual_brief: The central tower of Abraj Al Bait has a broad green-glass shaft, enormous clock faces, Arabic calligraphy and a gold crescent-topped spire. It stands beside the Grand Mosque, surrounded by shorter stepped hotels. Classic frontal views from the mosque show the podium through the crescent; distinguish the central clock tower from the flanking hotels and nearby Jabal Omar towers.
notes: Seven verified photographs. Recommended: c2 for the fullest building view, c5 for warm colour, c6 for night. Base obstruction and cropping are noted individually. References were not reused.
